name: Lunar Reactions
desc: Lunar Reactions function similarly to Elemental Reactions. Both involve the combination of elements, but Lunar Reactions require specific conditions to replace or supplement the corresponding Elemental Reaction. They have an special Internal Cooldown each, but elemental application follows the same rules of the Elemental Gauge Theory as standard Elemental Reactions.

value.name: Damage Formula
value.desc: The Damage Formula is a calculation of all the elements that damage involves. It's a complex operation that requires the consideration of many things.

value.name: Elemental Reactions
value.desc:
Elemental Reactions represent the centerpiece of the combat system of Genshin Impact. Understanding and mastering these interactions can drastically improve one’s proficiency in battle.

There are multiple factors to consider when triggering Elemental Reactions, such as aura, trigger, decay, etc. Elemental Gauge Theory and Internal Cooldowns will play a major role to help players understand the complexity behind Elemental Reactions.

customize.text: Overview

With the introduction of Ineffa in version 5.8 and the Nod-Krai region in version Luna I, Lunar Reactions were also introduced. These are related not to the elements, but to a more ancient and purer energy.
In the game's combat interface, the damage numbers for Lunar Reactions are distinguished by appearing slightly tilted with a silver-colored base.
Similar to Elemental Reactions, they scale with the level and Elemental Mastery of the character(s) triggering them, and their damage is not increased by general DMG Bonuses or Elemental DMG Bonuses (e.g., Furina's DMG Bonus, or the Elemental DMG Bonus from a Goblet of Eonothem). However, unlike Elemental Reactions, they are capable of landing critical hits.
There are three types of Lunar Reactions: Lunar-Charged, Lunar-Bloom, and Lunar-Crystallize, which respectively replace and enhance the Transformative Reactions Electro-Charged, Bloom, and Crystallize when the corresponding Moon Wheel character is in the party. Lunar-Charged retains the mechanics of Electro-Charged while dealing Lunar-Charged DMG instead; Lunar-Bloom enables certain attacks and abilities to deal Lunar-Bloom DMG without affecting the behavior of Dendro Cores; Lunar-Crystallize generates Moondrifts instead of Crystallize Shards, while still counting as obtaining one for related effects.
Lunar-Charged

Lunar-Charged replaces Electro-Charged. Upon activation, thunderclouds form above enemies affected by both Hydro and Electro.
These clouds strike every 2 seconds, and disappear 4 seconds after the enemy is no longer affected by both elements.
Damage is calculated based on the stats of the characters involved — however, contributions are weighted unevenly. After calculating each individual value, the highest is taken, and half of the second, plus one-twelfth of the third and fourth, are added. A character's participation in Thundercloud damage depends on whether they have applied their element within the last 5 seconds.

<color=#ffffffd9>Thundercloud Final Lunar-Charged DMG =</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>= Highest DMG + (1/2 × 2nd) + (1/12 × 3rd) + (1/12 × 4th)</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>Individual Lunar-Charged DMG =</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>= 180% × Character LVL Multiplier × (1 + Base Bonus %) ×</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>× (1 + EM Bonus + Lunar-Charged Bonus %) ×</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>× Enemy Electro RES × (100% + [CRIT DMG])</color>

In addition to the Thundercloud damage, Direct Lunar-Charged DMG also exists.
This version has a larger Reaction Multiplier and is triggered by specific abilities that replace the Character LVL Multiplier with a predefined Property.

<color=#ffffffd9>Direct Lunar-Charged DMG =</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>= 300% × Property × (1 + Base Bonus %) ×</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>× (1 + EM Bonus + Lunar-Charged Bonus %) ×</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>× Enemy Electro RES × (100% + [CRIT DMG])</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>Direct Lunar-Charged DMG Properties</color>

Lunar-Crystallize

After Geo meets Hydro, three Moondrifts will appear. After triggering 3 times the Crystallize reaction, the three Moondrifts will initiate Moondrift Harmony, which deals Lunar-Crystallize DMG to nearby opponents. That means three simultaneous Geo attacks, that will take the enemy on which the third Crystallize reaction was triggered as target. If another Crystallize reaction is triggered far enough from the Moondrifts, more of them will be created without destoying the previous ones.
Lunar-Crystallize is similar to Lunar-Charged. While the Individual Lunar-Charged DMG Formula uses a 180% multiplier, and the Direct Lunar-Charged DMG Formula uses 300%, the Lunar-Crystallize DMG Formula uses 96% and 160% respectively.

<color=#ffffffd9>Moondrifts Lunar-Crystallize DMG =</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>= 96% × Character LVL Multiplier × (1 + Base Bonus %) ×</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>× (1 + EM Bonus + Lunar-Crystallize Bonus %) ×</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>× Enemy Geo RES × (100% + [CRIT DMG])</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>Direct Lunar-Crystallize DMG =</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>= 160% × Property × (1 + Base Bonus %) ×</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>× (1 + EM Bonus + Lunar-Crystallize Bonus %) ×</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>× Enemy Geo RES × (100% + [CRIT DMG])</color>

Lunar-Bloom

Lunar-Bloom DMG is a form of direct damage, distinct from Bloom and from Dendro Cores.
When Dendro and Hydro react, instead of the usual "Bloom" animation, "Lunar-Bloom" appears — creating a regular Dendro Core and granting a stack of Verdant Dew to the team.
These stacks appear as a symbol of three small moons below the party icons on the mid-right side of the screen.
Each stack takes 2.5 seconds to fully charge before the next begins charging, up to three stacks in total.
If another Lunar Bloom is triggered before the current stack completes, the next one will begin charging immediately after.
Before reaching 3 stacks, some may remain partially filled, but when consumed, only fully charged stacks are used.
Any partial progress is preserved as long as the Lunar Bloom Enabler remains there.
The Dendro Cores created by Lunar-Bloom behave identically to normal Bloom Cores — they may detonate naturally, become Nilou’s Bountiful Cores, or trigger Hyperbloom or Burgeon when infused with Electro or Pyro.
In all cases, their damage remains Transformative Reaction DMG without any change.
Just like Direct Lunar-Charged DMG, Lunar-Bloom DMG uses a predefined Property from the triggering character.
However, its Reaction Multiplier is 100%, allowing it to be effectively ignored in the formula.

<color=#ffffffd9>Lunar-Bloom DMG =</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>= Property × (1 + Base Bonus %) ×</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>× (1 + EM Bonus + Lunar-Bloom Bonus%)</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>× Enemy Dendro RES × (100% + [CRIT DMG])</color>
<color=#ffffffd9>Lunar-Bloom DMG Properties</color>

EM Bonus Multiplier

When <color=#ffd680>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color> is active, and non-Moonsign characters use their Skills or Bursts, the Elemental Mastery Bonus (EM Bonus) can be further increased by up to 36% in total.
The increase depends on the element of the character activating their Skill or Burst, and on the corresponding stat:
Hydro: +0.6% per 1000 Max HP
Pyro / Electro / Cryo: +0.9% per 100 ATK
Geo: +1% per 100 DEF
Anemo / Dendro: +2.25% per 100 EM

Enemies

customize.name: Close Combat Scout Landcruiser
customize.desc:
An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."
These walking Landcruisers with bipedal structures are often used as "scouts," for they are able to quickly traverse rough terrain and reach key positions to seize the initiative for their allies. Their close-combat-oriented rotating blades allow them to deal fatal damage to their foes and shred shrubbery and obstacles to open the way, allowing units to operate with ease even amidst thick vegetation.

customize.name: Close Combat Storm Landcruiser
customize.desc:
An autonomous machine that applies the principles of naval combat to land battles, a literal "armed ship that cruises on land."
Equipped with Crawler Track Movement Mechanisms, these Landcruisers are normally used to storm enemy positions, where they can pass over rough terrain such as mud and melting snow despite heavy armor and armaments through their excellent load-bearing capabilities and off-road mobility. When close-combat Landcruisers approach enemy defensive lines in formation, rotating blades raised for battle, most foes will concentrate fire on them, allowing other units the opportunity to unleash their firepower...

customize.name: Cutting Edge All-Purpose Storm Landcruiser
customize.desc:
Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline.
The all-purpose storm combat package combines multi-barrel automatic guns with close-quarter rotating blades, allowing this Landcruiser to battle opponents at any range, while heavy howitzers on both arms allow it to obliterate cover and deny defenders the benefit of their fortifications. According to combat doctrine co-authored by the Fatui and the Royal Military Academy, these Landcruisers must be supported by all nearby units when they attack, speedily punching a hole in enemy lines, which will allow for follow-up attacks in depth that will then cause the enemy defenses to collapse completely.

customize.name: Cutting Edge All-Purpose Scout Landcruiser
customize.desc:
Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline.
The all-purpose scout combat package is designed for both long- and short-range combat, and not only leads scout Landcruiser squads, but also provides close support for All-Purpose Storm Landcruisers during high-intensity battles, such as crossing specialized anti-Landcruiser trenches, or destroying enemy strongpoints. This Landcruiser type can also keep up with the tip of the spear as it breaks through in depth, before swinging out to the wings and swiftly attacking key targets in the enemy's rear lines.

customize.name: Cutting Edge Fire Support Ground Effect Landcruiser
customize.desc:
Balancing cutting-edge tech, production costs, and sortie rates, these elite Landcruisers confer immense penetrative power upon any order of battle, and are the key fulcrum of the frontline.
After being equipped with high-efficiency jet engines, this Ground Effect Landcruiser has gained the ability to carry multiple armaments, allowing it to deliver this sizable firepower anywhere on the battlefield in a timely fashion. As such, the combat doctrine co-authored by the Fatui and the Royal Military Academy states that they are to be organized as a "Quick Reaction Force" in large-scale battles, meant to guard against enemy breakthroughs or counterattacks, and to press the advantage if the battle is going favorably. Of course, all such Landcruisers have the ability to operate independently, and on long tours of duty, they can form the core of a small squad and thus maximize the firepower of various Fatui unit types...

customize.text: While they are using kuuvahki, they can be stopped by being attacked with Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reactions.

customize.name: Knuckle Duckle
customize.desc:
A kuuvahki mechanism of peculiar make, made from scrap metal and mechanical bearings, that bears a partial resemblance — as per its creator's proclivities, apparently — to a "duck."
Its output and resistance to damage are comparable to the Fatui's most cutting-edge warfighting weaponry... But even so, it remains simply a toy duck that can punch its opponents very, very hard. A creator's preferences will always do much to determine a creation's appearance, as clay lacks the authority to question its creator's choice of molds. The world beneath the moon has long been sculpted into a form that people take for granted, but in the eyes of its original inhabitants, that form must surely be like a peculiar duck, shaped by its creator's bizarre predilections.
Of course, the blue-haired maid would never say any such thing to the mistress of the Krumkake Craftshop — after all, ducks are adorable, especially compared to the world's present aspect.

customize.text: Stamping Devices' circuits can be fried by destroying them or dealing DMG with Electro-Charged or Lunar-Charged reactions, and cause them to attack Knuckle Duckle's Ward instead.

customize.name: Raskolnikov
customize.desc: Employed at the titanic Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau, Poruchik Raskolnikov fulfills his role as a cog in the machine perfectly, executing every order without question, and doing his duty in silence and with precision.

customize.text: While Raskolnikov's dome shield is deployed, Electro-Charged and Lunar-Charged reactions are especially effective at breaking it.

customize.name: Blazing Brilliance: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Pyro, resulting in its present form.
One of the manifestations with the most violent temperament, even at the frigid edges of the world, it is wreathed in unquenchable flame.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Surging Currents: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Hydro, resulting in its present form.
Its clear, glass-like body is composed almost entirely of the purest water droplets. Though gentler than most of its kin, once provoked it can instantly shape the surrounding water into razor-sharp blades capable of piercing any unwary intruder's defenses.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.name: Veiled Cloudchaser: Frostnight Scion
customize.desc:
An elegant elemental life form that possesses immense elemental affinity. The long years have exposed it to high concentrations of Anemo, resulting in its present form.
The flowing wind has spun an extra pair of wings for it. As it almost never leaves footprints on the ground, it's also known as the one who walks with the wind.
In still-extant prayers of the far north, it was born from the Frost Moon's blessings, symbolizing the pure source and the first radiance. Perhaps this is why it finds the tainting of its pale purity with the seven colors of heavenly light unbearable, thus rejecting all life that draws too close.

customize.text: Deal DMG to Frostnight Scions using elemental attacks of the same elemental type as them or by using Lunar Reactions to illuminate them and force them to leave their Gloomveiled state.

customize.name: Frostnight Herra
customize.desc:
Proud beings that roam in the waning glow of the moon, wielding ancient powers long since tamed by the Lord of the Sky.
Legends say these graceful, mystical beasts were born in the age when the Frost Moon still turned, and, favored by the divine emissary, they would not be tainted by the light of day. Even now, among the followers of the Frost Moon, they are regarded as sacred beasts lost to this world, retreating along secret lunar paths beyond the reach of mortal eyes. Yet, as they have for countless centuries past, they still wander in the shadows of the moon, treading the boundary between two worlds, guarding the lands coveted by calamity, and watching over those who dwell within them — for this is the very oath they first swore to the apostle of the golden city.

customize.name: Lord of the Hidden Depths: Whisperer of Nightmares
customize.desc:
An Abyssal creature that creeps through rifts in the hidden depths, quietly watching this world. Its eerie, faceless form is said to be nothing more than a projection, for its true body exists only as a formless mass of pure Abyssal energy.
Even invaders who seek to claim this world must obey its rules to some extent. Unless the heavens split open and the earth's defenses collapse, these star-born outsiders can do little more than linger at the world's fringes, whispering their madness into this realm, their attempts to seep inside amounting to nothing... But how long can this stability and order truly last?

customize.name: Fisher of Hidden Depths
customize.desc:
An Abyssal creature that slips through rifts in the hidden depths, crossing over from beyond this world.
Long ago, an ancient philosopher described humans as "featherless bipeds," using that simple phrase to distinguish mankind from animals and assert human superiority. In some sense, these deathless wanderers of the silent cosmic void, scaled instead of feathered, and using their hooked beaks to draw in biomass from world to world, might actually also match that same simplistic definition of "human."

customize.text: Lunar Reaction DMG is especially effective at breaking the shield.
